{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep highest sample_seq per patient
df_dedup = df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset='patient_id', keep='first')

# Filter to treatment arm only
treatment_only = df_dedup[df_dedup['arm'] == 'treatment']

# Compute response fraction
n_treatment = len(treatment_only)
n_responded = treatment_only['responded'].sum()
response_fraction = n_responded / n_treatment

# Print the exact values used in evidence
print(n_treatment)
print(n_responded)
print(response_fraction)

# Round to 3 decimal places for final answer
final_fraction = round(response_fraction, 3)
print(final_fraction)"}
